Package com.saicone.gama.util.jar

Class JarRuntime

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractMap<String,Class<?>>
java.util.HashMap<String,Class<?>>
java.util.LinkedHashMap<String,Class<?>>
com.saicone.gama.util.jar.JarRuntime
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, Map<String,Class<?>>, SequencedMap<String,Class<?>>
public class JarRuntime extends LinkedHashMap<String,Class<?>>
An object that save classes from a code source.
This class offers utility methods to iterate hover cached classes.

    • put

      @Nullable public @Nullable Class<?> put(@NotNull @NotNull String name)
      Put a class in the runtime cache. If the class cannot be loaded, it will be cached as Object.class.
      Parameters:
      name - the class name to load and put.
      Returns:
      the previously cached class, or null if there was no mapping for the class name.
